description:
“In my hospital...they wanted me to use Remdesivir. We know according to the WHO, Remdesivir increases your risk of kidney failure 20-fold, your risk of renal failure 20-fold & increases your risk of dying by about 4%. It has no place in medicine, yet the federal government will give hospitals a 20% bonus ...if you prescribe this toxic medication” - Paul Marik, MDShow more Sen. Ron Johnson Roundtable Discussion: Covid-19 Vaccines: What They Are, How They Work and Possible Causes of Injuries. December 7, 2022
